brief: Fact condition별 구조 후보와 Rule 평가별 의미 후보를 분리하고 결정적 identity와 상태·참조 무결성을 검증한다.

goals.title: 기초 candidate domain 구현
goals.objective: 상태 enum, evidence, diagnostic, constraint 모델을 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: compileJava completed for candidate enums, EvidenceRef, CandidateDiagnostic and NormalizedConstraint.

goals.title: 구조 및 의미 후보 구현
goals.objective: PredicateCandidate와 BusinessRuleCandidate의 immutable 지역 invariant를 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: candidate records compile and example tests cover evidence, confidence, defensive copy and state separation.

goals.title: Aggregate 및 validator 구현
goals.objective: 결과 aggregate와 상태·참조 무결성 validator를 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: duplicate IDs, dangling predicate/evidence references and invalid status combinations are rejected.

goals.title: Identity 및 Fact support 구현
goals.objective: 결정적 ID, typed Fact classifier, Evidence mapper와 business rule factory를 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: SHA-256 candidate IDs, Fact payload/edge classifier, source-range evidence mapping and validated factory compile and pass tests.

goals.title: Accumulator 구현
goals.objective: 결정적 정렬, duplicate 검출, immutable snapshot과 integrity validation을 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: accumulator example tests verify stable snapshot, duplicate rejection and dangling evidence rejection.

goals.title: Example-based tests 구현
goals.objective: 대표 상태 조합, 분류, evidence, aggregate와 immutability를 검증한다.

goals.title: jqwik properties 구현
goals.objective: candidate identity와 상태 invariant properties를 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: 4 properties passed with 500/500/200/200 tries and recorded reproduction seeds.

goals.title: 전체 검증
goals.objective: 신규, Fact, baseline, legacy와 전체 regression 및 scoped diff를 검증한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: full Gradle suite 65 tests across 19 suites; 0 failures/errors/skips; scoped diff check passed; existing output and Unit 01 Fact files unchanged in Unit 02.

goals.title: PBT identity generator domain 수정
goals.objective: 공백 문자열을 만들던 범용 jqwik generator를 유효 영문 identity domain generator로 교체한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: valid identity generator applied; candidate test suite 12/12 passed and full suite passed.
